verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks, which send outbound HTTP requests with row payloads to any endpoint, including Edge Functions, on table INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE events. They are built on triggers and pg_net, so a programmatic consumer can register and receive real event callbacks. Missing for 10: webhook coverage beyond table events (e.g., auth, storage or project-level events), documented delivery guarantees such as retries and payload signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
